# WC1 · Tìm bệnh nhân

Group **WC · Hồ sơ & Patient 360** · page · Next.js: **built (U1)** (`/patients`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/clinic.js#patients`
- Patient 360 is `clinic.js › patient360()`: hero, tab bar (`data-tab`), then one body per tab. `care-finance.js` injects the linked service/prescription panels under every tab except `crm` and `history`.
- `clinic.js › patients()`: search `#patient-search` (name, code, concern, phone), filter chips `data-patient-filter` (`all`, `active`, `next`, `alerts`), table 46 rows, "＋ Hồ sơ mới" opens the create dialog WC3. Only patients the account owns are listed (`Staff.owns`).
- Page key `patients` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, care, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"patients\"]"}; it must show `#patient-search`.

## Next.js target
- Route: `/patients` · status: **built (U1)** · U step: U1
- FEATURE-INVENTORY row: `/patients` "Hồ sơ bệnh nhân" (owner U1); test ids: `src/lib/ops/format.test.ts`
- Existing page file: `pema-agent/frontend/src/app/(admin)/patients/page.tsx`

## Business rules
- Clinical actions need the `clinical` capability (owner, doctor); without it `action()` answers "Cần tài khoản bác sĩ để thực hiện." and `staff-context.js › apply()` removes the controls.
- "Tái khám tuần này" = next visit between 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-27; "Đang điều trị" = completed < total; "Có cảnh báo" = alerts not empty.

## Differences from the app design
- App A3 is titled "Hồ sơ người bệnh" with 12 sample rows; the web title is "Tìm bệnh nhân", the count chip "46 hồ sơ" and 4 filter chips.
- Next.js /patients: search only. Missing against the old web: filter chips (Tất cả, Đang điều trị, Tài khám tuần này, Có cảnh báo), the ＋ Hồ sơ mới dialog (WC3; POST /patients exists) and the journey and next-visit columns. Fix needed, PARITY-AI01-U section 5.

## Gotchas
- Opening a patient from the list is a row click (`tr[data-patient]`) or the "Mở →" button; the tab is kept in the module variable `tab`, so a re-render keeps it.
- Phone numbers are masked in the demo ("09•• ••• 100").
- Canvas: rows 2-7 of the sample table carry the other six concern chips ("Mụn viêm" ... "Theo dõi da sau điều trị"); the generated Layout lists only the first table row, so they are exempted through demo_data. The avatar, name link and "P001 · 28 tuổi · phone" line share one cell.
